description: Falsifiable predictions of the diagrammatic-double-magic / LR-fusion-rigidity conjecture for the seven double-magic isotopes on the magic ladder {2, 8, 20, 28, 50, 82, 126}. Records what the conjecture *predicts* (kappa_A = 0, dominant lambda_A self-conjugate, A on the magic ladder). Row vectors are filled in for n in {8, 20, 28, 50, 82, 126} from enumerate_self_conjugate_partitions.py (canonical = most-square-like self-conjugate partition); n=2 has no self-conjugate partition (the conjecture is degenerate at this strand count and the empirical magic-2 shell of He-4 must be interpreted via a separate mechanism — open question recorded in the conjecture .md).

axiomatised_components: ShellCondensationConjecture.collapse_iff_magic (the BB-stratum coincidence with the magic ladder)
DoubleMagicConjecture.lr_rigidity (LR-fusion preserves self-conjugacy at saturated inputs)

isotopes.name: He-4
isotopes.notes: DEGENERATE: there is no self-conjugate partition of 2 (distinct odd parts summing to 2 is empty). The empirical magic-2 shell of He-4 cannot be the strict-self-conjugacy case of the conjecture; an alternative mechanism (perhaps direct vacuum-state stability, or Saturated-spectrum-trivial degeneracy) is required. Open question — recorded in the conj:categorical-neutrality-saturated-shells .md.

isotopes.name: O-16
isotopes.notes: Doubly-magic O-16. 2 self-conjugate partitions of 8 exist; canonical (most square-like) is [3, 3, 2]. Hoefsmit verifiable at k=4.

isotopes.name: Ca-40
isotopes.notes: Doubly-magic Ca-40. 7 self-conjugate partitions of 20 exist; canonical is [5, 5, 4, 4, 2]. At the edge of Hoefsmit tractability (k=10). delta^2 Phi peak +20.4 in shell-closure.witness.json corroborates.

isotopes.name: Ni-56
isotopes.notes: Doubly-magic Ni-56. 16 self-conjugate partitions of 28 exist; canonical is [6, 6, 5, 5, 4, 2]. Beyond Hoefsmit horizon (k=14 > 10) — the conjecture supplies the prediction, no matrix evaluation can verify.

isotopes.name: Sn-100
isotopes.notes: Doubly-magic Sn-100. 98 self-conjugate partitions of 50 exist; canonical is [8, 7, 7, 7, 7, 7, 6, 1]. Far beyond Hoefsmit horizon. Empirically observed; this is a structural pre-prediction of the homological framework.

isotopes.name: Pb-208
isotopes.notes: Doubly-magic Pb-208 (heaviest known stable doubly-magic). 881 self-conj of 82, 10422 self-conj of 126. Canonicals listed. Cross-shell LR-fusion; way beyond matrix evaluation.

isotopes.name: magic-126-symmetric
isotopes.notes: Hypothetical Z=N=126 isotope (A=252 superheavy regime, not observed). 10422 self-conj of 126; canonical listed. Structural test of LR-rigidity at the heaviest magic number.

validation_notes.kappa_A_zero_provenance: Provenance of kappa_A = 0: kappa_zero_of_self_conjugate (proved in QOU/BraidKnot/ShellNeutrality.lean for an arbitrary self-conjugate Young diagram in the abstract Multiset model) + content additivity (axiomatised typeclass field, derivable from the LR rule).
validation_notes.lambda_A_self_conjugacy_provenance: Provenance of lambda_A self-conjugate: DoubleMagicConjecture.lr_rigidity, axiomatised as a Lean typeclass field. Falsifiable by direct LR-coefficient computation at saturated inputs for any tractable case (k <= 10).
validation_notes.magic_ladder_membership: A in {4, 16, 40, 56, 100, 208, 252} for the listed cases. {4, 16, 40, 56, 100, 208} are observationally double-magic; A = 252 is hypothetical.
future_work: Enumerate self-conjugate partitions of each magic n via the bijection with partitions into distinct odd parts; record explicit row vectors for lambda_Z, lambda_N.
Compute LR coefficients numerically for the (lambda_Z, lambda_N) self-conjugate pairs at k <= 10 to test dominance of the predicted self-conjugate lambda_A.
Lean-formalise content additivity from a concrete Young-diagram model in Mathlib once Mathlib.Combinatorics.Young.YoungDiagram is wired into the QOU build.
